name: algomaker

scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:web
scripts._comment:test:web: The dashboard suite is vitest+jsdom, not node:test — node --test cannot run JSX, which is why every web test that touches the DOM is .test.tsx and is NOT matched by the glob above (a plain .test.ts in apps/web/test IS matched, and runs under test:node — see apps/web/vitest.config.ts). Running only test:node reports green while the dashboard is untested.
scripts._comment:typecheck: Two projects, because the root tsconfig excludes apps/web (its own JSX/DOM setup). Running only the first reports green while the dashboard is unchecked.

_comment:dependencies: The four legacy packages here (authenticator, debug, request, tough-cookie-filestore) exist for ONE file: packages/marketdata-core/vendor/zerodha.js, the vendored Kite web login. They are kept only while the native-fetch login carries a DESK_LEGACY_ZERODHA_LOGIN=1 fallback to it; when that fallback retires, all four go with it. `kiteconnect` was removed (2026-08-16): the only mention of it left in the tree is a usage example inside a comment in the vendored KiteTicker.
